newsitems.title: Watch the Hades Orchestral Concert, Live from London!
newsitems.author: kid_zomb
newsitems.contents:
On June 27 at London's Royal Festival Hall, our composer and audio director Darren Korb will be joined by his fellow [b]Hades[/b] vocalists and conductor Austin Wintory in a one-time-only orchestral concert, [b][url=https://gamemusic.net/events/ballads-of-the-underworld-featuring-music-from-hades-and-hades-2/]Ballads of the Underworld[/url][/b]! If you've enjoyed the music of [b]Hades[/b] and [b]Hades II[/b], or any of our games, you do not want to miss this once-in-a-lifetime performance. 

[h2]Tune in Live on Twitch[/h2]
Since not everyone can make it to London to be there in person, we're very pleased to announce we'll be hosting a free live stream of the entire concert, in partnership with Twitch! Simply visit [url=https://twitch.tv/supergiantgames]twitch.tv/supergiantgames[/url] on [b]Saturday June 27 5:30am PDT / 8:30am EST / 1:30pm BST[/b] (your local time may vary), and enjoy the show. It's our small way of saying thank you to all our players for your support of the [b]Hades[/b] games, as well as Darren's music!

[url=http://twitch.tv/supergiantgames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/aad983f32d27d927f5cc178938d011eb28363d3c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]About the Concert[/h2]
[b]Ballads of the Underworld[/b] is a live concert with music by our award-winning composer Darren Korb, featuring songs from [b]Hades[/b] and [b]Hades II[/b], and more! Remember easing your burdens with Eurydice as she sings [i]Good Riddance[/i]? Or taking on Scylla and the Sirens as they rock out with [i]Coral Crown[/i]? You'll hear these and all your favorite tracks from both games during the performance!

Darren will be joined by vocalist Ashley Barrett, whose voice is featured in each of our games since [b]Bastion[/b], as well as special guests Judy Alice Lee (voice of Melinoë), Erin Yvette (voice of Scylla and Dora), and Colin Ryan (voice of Apollo), all with orchestral accompaniment by the [url=https://www.londonmozartplayers.com/]London Mozart Players[/url] conducted by Austin Wintory. This is a one-time-only event taking place at London's Royal Festival Hall.

For more information, visit the [url=https://gamemusic.net/events/ballads-of-the-underworld-featuring-music-from-hades-and-hades-2/]Ballads of the Underworld official website[/url].

newsitems.title: Hades II v1.0 Is Now Available!
newsitems.author: kid_zomb
newsitems.contents:
We couldn't possibly be more excited to announce that we've completed the Early Access development of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i], and officially launched v1.0 of the game!! Whether you've been playing all through Early Access or this will be your very first foray into our take on the Underworld of Greek myth, we welcome you and thank you for joining us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145350/Hades_II/
[h2]About the Game[/h2]
[i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] is a rogue-like dungeon crawler in which you'll battle beyond the Underworld of Greek myth using dark sorcery to take on the sinister Titan of Time. Our studio's first-ever sequel builds on the best aspects of the award-winning original in an all-new, action-packed, endlessly replayable experience rooted in the Underworld of Greek myth and its deep connections to the dawn of witchcraft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/d12cbc61b6c238129d58e5bb9f5abca4c962b31f.jpg[/img]
As the immortal Princess of the Underworld, you'll explore a bigger, deeper mythic world, vanquishing the forces of the Titan of Time with the full might of Olympus behind you, in a sweeping story that continually unfolds through your every setback and accomplishment. New locations, challenges, upgrade systems, and surprises await as you delve into the ever-shifting Underworld again and again. For more information, check the [url=https://www.supergiantgames.com/blog/hades2-faq]Hades II FAQ[/url] on our website.

[h2]About the Hades II Original Soundtrack[/h2]
The completion of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] also marks the completion of the [b]Hades II Original Soundtrack[/b] by our award-winning composer Darren Korb. Much like the game itself, this is our biggest-ever soundtrack, clocking in at just under four hours of music created for this game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950840/Hades_II_Original_Soundtrack/
If you've been enjoying the soundtrack already, know that we've saved some of the best for last! The soundtrack is available here on Steam or free streaming on [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL53mjgVKFq7yeq21XhibC8izNSVlPCsNP]our YouTube channel[/url] or other services.

[h2]Thank You for Playing!![/h2]
While [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] spent more than four-and-a-half years in development, including about a year and a half in Early Access, it's also the culmination of all the experience we've gained together as a team since Supergiant Games started back in 2009. Early Access development was foundational to the entire idea of the original [i][b]Hades[/b][/i], and proved instrumental to this latest game as well. So, from all of us, thank you for inspiring us to do our best, and we hope you enjoy your time with [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i]. [i]May moonlight guide you![/i]

newsitems.title: Hades: It's the Five-Year Anniversary!
newsitems.author: kid_zomb
newsitems.contents:
Five years have flown by since the v1.0 launch of [i][b]Hades[/b][/i], our studio's fourth game! It went on to earn more than 70 Game of the Year awards, exceeding our wildest expectations. We're now just days away from launching [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1145350/view/512967793587520056?l=english]our first-ever sequel[/url] that we've been working on ever since, and wanted to commemorate the anniversary of the original.

[h2]Watch the [i]Hades[/i] Anniversary Live Stream![/h2]
Join our studio director Amir Rao and creative director Greg Kasavin for a trip down memory lane as they reacquaint themselves with the world of the original [i][b]Hades[/b][/i], after having been deep in the world of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] for some time! And please enjoy this new art piece featuring Zagreus, Megaera, and Thanatos by our resident illustrator, Jeremy Anninos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/af1733d629a1d5f905691d5a93425394b1b4f622.png[/img]
We'll be streaming right here on Steam, as well as YouTube and Twitch.

[h2]Listen to the 'In the Blood' Anniversary Mix![/h2]
We're pleased to present this new orchestral rendition of [i]In the Blood[/i], the end theme from [i][b]Hades[/b][/i], featuring the voices of our audio director and composer Darren Korb  along with Ashley Barrett, accompanied by a full orchestra recorded at Abbey Road Studios, Studio 1:
[previewyoutube=TRSpQDZMctA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Get [i]Hades[/i] for 75% Off![/h2]
If you've been putting off a trip to the Underworld, [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] is having its biggest sale ever!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145350/Hades_II/
Why not dive in again either for the first time or for old time's sake, and get set for [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] next week -- though, no prior experience is needed to enjoy the sequel!

[h2][i]Hades[/i] Anniversary Sale @ Fangamer[/h2]
Our friends at [url=https://www.fangamer.com/collections/hades]Fangamer[/url] are having a big sale on our official [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] merchandise collection if there's anything there that catches your eye!

[url=https://www.fangamer.com/collections/hades][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/81bc3461462b030b038ca0c22b8ac1c2f18d988a.png[/img][/url]
We've got everything from prints and apparel to plushies and desk mats. [url=https://www.fangamer.com/collections/hades]Visit the official Hades collection at Fangamer here[/url].

[h2]Claim figma Zagreus[/h2]
We're super excited to be working with [url=https://goodsmile.link/figmaZagreus]GoodSmile[/url] on this highly poseable and expressive action figure of the Underworld Prince, available for preorder just in time for this big day-or-night!

[url=https://goodsmile.link/figmaZagreus][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/7f573e319f1fee866bea330e8c19f24b82b57881.gif[/img][/url]
He's got the vicious blade Stygius, his father's spear, and more. [url=https://goodsmile.link/figmaZagreus]Preorder figma Zagreus here[/url].

[h2]Thank You for Playing!![/h2]
To everyone who played [i][b]Hades[/b][/i], thank you for all the inspiration and support! We're so grateful that [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] connected with so many players around the world. If you get a chance to play our next game, we hope you find it lives up! [i]In the name of Hades![/i]

newsitems.title: Hades 2 is so good even the first game has just beaten its own Steam record
newsitems.contents:
Hades 2 has quickly proven popular, and it's clearly gotten people in the mood for the original, as the 2020 roguelite has also seen a strong boost on Steam.

Last week, Supergiant decided to bless us with a surprise Hades 2 early access drop, so obviously we all immediately put down whatever we were playing and hopped straight into it. The sequel quickly shot up to Steam's top sellers pretty much straight after it was released, and if your timeline has been anything like mine, has rapidly taken a hold over every horny person under the sun. What's most impressive is that much like the first one, Hades 2 is just in early access, and yet it's already managed to hit more than double the original games all-time concurrent player count peak, amassing more than 100,000 players when it launched. However, clearly people are fancying more than what the sequel offers, as the first Hades has seen a big player count increase of its own over the weekend.

Previously, the game's concurrent player count record was 37,749, which it set back when it was released in 2020. However, over the weekend the game managed to climb up to a new record of 54,240 players, so clearly there will have been some returning and presumably new players all hopping back in off of the popularity of its sequel. I can't exactly blame them, Hades truly is a stellar piece of design, and has a story captivating enough to keep you moving throughout those occasionally brutal runs.

newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
There's a difference between good hard games and bad hard games. When difficulty is at its worst, you feel frustrated, and like it's impossible to make any meaningful progress. But when the greatest roguelikes get it right, your deaths and losses become a fundamental part of your emotional experience. Punishment as a mechanic. Game over as a reward. You lose weapons and resources, but you gain insight, and the joy of a gaming journey that's all yours. As Hades 2 draws near, its superlative predecessor remains a must play, and is now cheaper than ever.

newsitems.title: Critically acclaimed roguelike Hades descends onto Netflix Games for iOS on March 19
newsitems.contents:
Supergiant Games and Netflix have announced the popular action RPG Hades will arrive for iOS on March 19.

To play it, all you need is an iPhone or iPad running 16.0 or later, and a standard Netflix subscription. To get the game, sign into the Netflix app on your device, navigate to the games row, look for Hades, download it, and start playing.

The roguelike has you playing as Zagreus, the son of Hades, attempting to escape the Underworld with the help of various Olympic deities. In Hades, you’ll fight to escape the regions of Tartarus, Asphodel, Elysium, and the Temple of Styx before facing the God of the Underworld in a final battle.

newsitems.title: Netflix is getting one of the best roguelites around and more next year
newsitems.contents:
Hades, one of the best games from 2020, will be joining Netflix's lineup of mobile games next year, alongside a number of other titles.

It's currently Netflix Geeked Week, meaning the streaming giant has been announcing all sorts of new shows - including a Witcher anime that's bringing back Doug Cockle as Geralt. But, Netflix had more than just shows up its proverbial sleeve this week, as it also announced a slate of games that would be joining its gaming side of the service across 2024. The biggest and most exciting announcement is easily Supergiant's incredible roguelite Hades, which honestly feels like one of the most fitting titles to come to Netflix so far. It's got action, romance, comedy, all the right components for a Netflix hit, so maybe this will be the one that convinces users its games are worth playing (especially considering less than 1% of subscribers actually play its games daily).

Hades isn't the only game joining Netflix next year either. Death's Door, a tough-as-nails action game that isn't quite a Soulslike but certainly does have similarities to the genre's combat, is also coming to Netflix. Again, this one feels like a great fit for Netflix, I could easily see a show about a crow reaper going around collecting souls. There's also Katana Zero, a neo-noir action-platformer with "instant-death combat," and some stylish pixel art.

Read more

newsitems.title: Hades II: Coming to Steam Early Access!
newsitems.author: kid_zomb
newsitems.contents:
We are so excited to announce [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i], our studio's fifth game and first-ever sequel! Meet the Princess of the Underworld in our 4K reveal trailer, which premiered tonight at The Game Awards:
[previewyoutube=l-iHDj3EwdI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Coming to Early Access[/h1]
Like its predecessor, [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] will be available in Early Access here on Steam for some time leading up to its full v1.0 launch. Add [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] to your wishlist for a handy reminder when the time comes:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145350/Hades_II/
Feedback from our player community through the course of development was foundational to the design and vital to the quality of the original game, so we plan to reprise that type of process with [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i]. Expect more information about our Early Access sometime in 2023.

[h1]About the Game[/h1]
In [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i], you'll battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the sinister Titan of Time in an all-new, action-packed, endlessly replayable experience rooted in the Underworld of Greek myth and its deep connections to the dawn of witchcraft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/81224930018203bed49a9d7be18f4c61c844f059.jpg[/img]

This is a direct sequel taking place sometime after the events of the original game. No prior knowledge of the original [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] is needed, though there are plenty of connections!

As Melinoë, the immortal Princess of the Underworld, you'll explore a bigger, deeper mythic world, vanquishing the Titan's forces with the full might of Olympus behind you, in a sweeping story that continually unfolds through your every setback and accomplishment. New locations, challenges, upgrade systems, and surprises await as you delve into the ever-shifting Underworld again and again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/f9466100a3f75cf5ce6f5cdb757575b0c8e1a57d.jpg[/img]

Like her brother Zagreus from the original game, Melinoë is not a character of our own invention, and is based on an ancient Underworld deity thought to be related to Hades. What little ancient mythology exists about her was more than enough to make us want to explore her story and connection to her family, and in so doing, expand on our vision of the Underworld!

For more details, check our [url="https://www.supergiantgames.com/blog/hades2-faq"][b]Hades II FAQ[/b][/url]. Please note, much like with our past titles, we plan to leave many details for you to discover!

[h1]About Supergiant Games[/h1]
We are a small independent game studio based in San Francisco, CA. Since 2009, we have strived to make games that spark your imagination like the games you played as a kid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/925e19f4df3fa9b443a880363ca7b78eb386e89a.jpg[/img]

We now have more than 20 people on our team (a few more than on the original [i][b]Hades[/b][/i]), including all seven of the original members of the team that created our first game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/107100/Bastion/"][b][i]Bastion[/i][/b][/url], who have worked together in their respective roles on all our games ever since.

We work on one main new game project at a time, and [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] is that project for the foreseeable future. The original [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] earned more than 70 Game of the Year awards following its v1.0 launch in 2020, and grew into our most successful game. Now, we are doing our best to make a sequel that lives up to its predecessor, and stands strong on its own merits.

Your generous support is the reason we've been able to stick together as a team all this time, so thank you very much for believing in us and for your patience as we develop this game!
